Tooltip_AQoL_DismantleVehicle: Dismantle this vehicle with a welding mask and 10 propane torch uses. Stored items will drop on the ground. Salvage and Welding XP match dismantling a car wreck.
Tooltip_AQoL_VehicleUnavailable: This vehicle cannot be dismantled here.
Tooltip_AQoL_StopVehicle: Stop the vehicle and turn off the engine first.
Tooltip_AQoL_EmptySeats: All occupants must leave the vehicle first.
Tooltip_AQoL_RemoveAnimals: Remove all animals from the vehicle first.
Tooltip_AQoL_NeedTorch: Propane torch with at least 10 uses required.
